courses.subject: TURK
courses.title: Elementary Turkish I
courses.description: Introduces the essential elements of Turkish structure and vocabulary and aspects of Turkish culture. Aural comprehension, reading, speaking, and writing are stressed.

courses.subject: TURK
courses.title: Elementary Turkish II
courses.description: Continued instruction in the essential elements of Turkish structure and vocabulary and aspects of Turkish culture. Aural comprehension, reading, speaking, and writing are stressed.

courses.subject: TURK
courses.title: Intermediate Turkish I
courses.description: Second-year level instruction in the essential elements of Turkish structure and vocabulary and aspects of Turkish culture. Aural comprehension, reading, speaking, and writing are stressed. Introduces representative literary works.

courses.subject: TURK
courses.title: Intermediate Turkish II
courses.description: A proficiency-based course centered on reading, writing, speaking, and listening to Turkish with an emphasis on understanding the application of grammatical structures and vocabulary development through the study of literature.

courses.subject: TURK
courses.title: Advanced Turkish I
courses.description: Students in this advanced class will explore various discourses through media and literature in order to develop a deeper understanding of modern Turkish language.

courses.subject: TURK
courses.title: Advanced Turkish II
courses.description: This course explores various discourses of modern Turkish through media and literature to develop a deeper understanding of modern Turkish language and culture. The course will build on the students' existing skills in Turkish, as well as provide an opportunity to build new skills in reading, writing, and speech.
